data: Priča o Anki, djevojčici iz sirotišta koju posvoji bogata rođakinja. Nedugo nakon njezina dolaska rođakinja pokaže drugo lice pa razočarana Anka bježi natrag u sirotište. Put je vodi do ciglane u dubini šume, gdje pronalazi privremeni dom među radnicima grube vanjštine, ali topla srca. Ondje otkriva bajkovit svijet šumskih bića koja vide samo djeca bujne mašte. (A fairy tale based on Mate Lovrak's childrens novel "Anka the Brazilian". The story is set in the rural landscape of Central Europe at the beginning of the last century. Anka is an orphan girl adopted by a rich aunt. Shortly after Anka's arrival, the classy aunt shows a different face and a disappointed and depressed Anka flees, wanting to return to the orphanage. The road leads her to a brickyard in the depths of the forest, where she finds a temporary home among workers with a rough exterior but warm hearts. There he discovers the fairy-tale world of forest creatures that only children of great imagination see ...)

Priča o Anki, djevojčici iz sirotišta koju posvoji bogata rođakinja. Nedugo nakon njezina dolaska rođakinja pokaže drugo lice pa razočarana Anka bježi natrag u sirotište. Put je vodi do ciglane u dubini šume, gdje pronalazi privremeni dom među radnicima grube vanjštine, ali topla srca. Ondje otkriva bajkovit svijet šumskih bića koja vide samo djeca bujne mašte.

A fairy tale based on Mate Lovrak's childrens novel "Anka the Brazilian". The story is set in the rural landscape of Central Europe at the beginning of the last century. Anka is an orphan girl adopted by a rich aunt. Shortly after Anka's arrival, the classy aunt shows a different face and a disappointed and depressed Anka flees, wanting to return to the orphanage. The road leads her to a brickyard in the depths of the forest, where she finds a temporary home among workers with a rough exterior but warm hearts. There he discovers the fairy-tale world of forest creatures that only children of great imagination see ...
